what: Work panels (60% height, 40px apart) join in an endless horizontal strip. A big vertical-oval glass lens in the middle of the screen pulls the passing panel toward the center (zoom .4), warps it like a wave outside 42% from the edge, and spreads the color into three (dispersion 11). On the rim a thin accent-color ring glints as it circles. Pushing by drag (1.6x) or horizontal wheel (1.4x) makes it follow at a .09 share per step, and on release it glides with inertia .865, then when stopped for 120ms it snaps to the nearest panel at a .05 share. The faster it goes, the smaller the panels get, down to 25%, and when first entering the section it advances one slot. The center panel’s title floats up at 15% from the top in .4s, and the number (02/07) sits at 15% from the bottom

options.height: Panel height (share of Section height), default 0.6
options.maxWidth: Max width of the widest board (share of section width), default 0.78
options.aspect: Default panel aspect ratio, default 1.6 — data-aspect per panel
options.shrink: Share that shrinks when fast, default 0.25
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One panel (child) — if it contains an img or video, that image is shown, otherwise a placeholder panel is drawn with the data-label text. Ratio via data-aspect
options.[data-fx-part=content]: (inside the panel) text group to move into the title cell when it reaches the center
